# `manualMetricTapToTrack`

Suggests Effect.trackSuccesses/trackErrors/trackDefects when an Effect.tap/tapError/tapDefect only updates a metric

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377154` |
| Language Service name | `manualMetricTapToTrack` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/manual-metric-tap-to-track` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect, Metric } from "effect"

const responseSize = Metric.gauge("response_size")

declare const handleRequest: Effect.Effect<number, Error>

export const instrumented = handleRequest.pipe(Effect.tap((size) => Metric.update(responseSize, size)))
/**
                                               ^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(manual-metric-tap-to-track): `Effect.trackSuccesses` expresses recording a metric on every success directly.
*/
```

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "manualMetricTapToTrack": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
